firstPlayerRule: Randomly determine the player who gets the Starting player token.
clarifications: Starting Food depends on turn order: the Starting player and the player to their left get 1 Food, the third player gets 2, and each other player gets 3.
In the Work phase, the Starting player places first, then play continues clockwise.
The token is not passed at the end of a round; a player becomes Starting player only by using the "Starting player" Action space.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the English rules linked from Lookout Games' Caverna: The Cave Farmers page (lookout-spiele.de/en/games/caverna.html) and extracted text from PDF pages 1, 2, 8 and 22. Page 2: 'Randomly determine the player who gets the Starting player token', followed by the Food-by-position rule. Page 8: work phase begins with the Starting player, clockwise. Page 22: the token is not passed at round end; only the Starting player Action space changes it. Components (7 Home boards, Dwarf discs, Ruby gems) match the full base game, BGG 102794, not the two-player Cave vs Cave. SHA-256: 78ff760339bfaded920800e685d78c8b663ec78b187613e2a0251ba3e739e635. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
